title: The complete-graph product recurrence order conjecture
statement: Let $K_k$ be the complete graph on $k$ vertices, let $P_n$ be the path graph on $n$ vertices, and consider the spanning-tree recurrence for the graph product $K_k\times P_n$. **Complete-graph product recurrence order conjecture.** The recurrence for the graph $K_k\times P_n$ has order $k$. This predicts an exact recurrence order for spanning-tree counts of complete-graph products with paths; the source provides no evidence of resolution.
source_name: Paul Raff, “Spanning Trees in Grid Graphs”, arXiv:0809.2551 (2008).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/0809.2551

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2008).
